title: ACIS reader provenance and actual consumer boundaries
mode: Primary-source repository/application documentation and open PR timeline review; research-only plan refinement
scope: Resolve whether ProGPU's documented SAT/SAB parser is an active application reader or an independent semantic route.
Verify whether ordinary open-source OCCT and stock FreeCAD builds supply a usable ACIS SAT/SAB geometry reader.
Recheck ACadSharp release, ACIS writer PR, schema refactor, and solid-writer issue boundaries.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 route admission and implementation-readiness steps without expanding dependencies or claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary GitHub project documentation, release pages, and issue/PR discussions
method.limitations: GitHub main/master documentation and open PRs are mutable snapshots. ProGPU source code and runtime were not built or executed; ACadSharp PR branches were not checked out or tested; FreeCAD/OCCT installations were not run. This review establishes evidence boundaries and does not claim exhaustive repository discovery or any local format defect.

sources.observed: DXF.md describes an experimental AcisSabParser that scans SAT/SAB and projects edge line segments. The architecture assigns document/file-format ownership to ACadSharp and says the older ProGPU.Dxf ACIS readers and shader were inspected and rejected as unrelated, incomplete sources.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documentation of an experimental renderer projection only. It does not establish an active parser call path, ACIS grammar correctness, complete body coverage, or B-rep semantics.

sources.revision: Public component announcement and preview repository reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The project describes ACIS SAT/SAB and DXF import/export as commercial data-exchange components, separate from the standard open-source OCCT exchange set.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Availability/licensing boundary only; not a runtime result for FreeCAD or any local environment.

sources.observed: The DXF documentation distinguishes the stock C++ importer from an optional legacy importer, says embedded ACIS solids cannot currently be read, and describes DWG as an external-converter-to-DXF flow.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documents the stated consumer contract, not a tested runtime or a judgment of libdxfrw carrier correctness.

sources.revision: Release and live PR/issue pages reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The v3.8.0 release is a pinned baseline distinct from mutable master and open PR heads. The reviewed #1150, #1174, and #1240 pages remain open/undeployed. #1150's thread records branch-specific carrier-write work, reported repeated-group-310 and reader-refactor conflicts, and the maintainer's preference for a schema-aware writer redesign. #1240 includes unmerged ModelerGeometry writer work. Issue #1195 remains a release-specific report of silent solid omission against 3.4.9.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Unmerged branch discussion and version-specific issue reports; no current-release writer qualification, independent B-rep result, or local libdxfrw defect.

assessment.planImpact: The ProGPU ACIS parser is marked as an unverified experimental renderer projection, not an admitted parser/semantic route. Stock FreeCAD and standard OCCT routes are separated from optional modeler/commercial components. ACadSharp release behavior, open PR heads, and branch reports are kept distinct. Existing local carrier/owner work continues without blocking on optional kernel or peer availability.

implementationReadyChecks: For ProGPU, require exact application commit, actual importer/parser call path, reader lineage, and per-source-entity output before counting even a rendering observation; never count the documented edge parser as an independent ACIS/B-rep reader.
Do not assume a stock OCCT or FreeCAD installation has the commercial SAT/SAB component. Name and pin any add-on or licensed exchange component as a separate optional route.
Under stock FreeCAD, score only entities the selected DXF importer consumes; classify ACIS solids as consumer-not-applicable unless a separately identified modeler route is exercised.

Treat ACadSharp release, master, and each open PR head as separate artifacts. A writer result must bind the exact commit, base/head, format direction/version, owner/key payload mapping, warnings, and independent result surface.

Continue deterministic local carrier capture, owner/key closure, loss accounting, and fail-closed output work without waiting for an optional full ACIS kernel. At the composed checkpoint, test standalone payload semantics separately from container association and report every unsupported/fallback disposition.
If a pinned parser or external runtime is unavailable, record NOT_RUN and continue; add no dependency, committed fixture, peer runtime, native run, or support promotion in this research-only update.
